name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a conditional rule, not a goal — the exit is only the 'if' condition, so at_exit is not commanded and needs no Existence. The hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) captures exactly 'if you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first', and the empty FINAL_STATES with the rule-only warning is valid for this restriction-only task.

texts: If the agent reaches the exit, it must have toggled the switch first.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
